sloka: एकेषुपातेन भृशं निपात्य लोकत्रयस्यापि रघुप्रवीरः ।विनिर्बभावुत्तमचापबाणस्तमः प्रणुद्येव सहस्ररश्मिः ।। ७.६९.३९ ॥
transliteration: ekeṣupātena bhṛśaṁ nipātya lokatrayasyāpi raghupravīraḥ ।vinirbabhāvuttamacāpabāṇastamaḥ praṇudyeva sahasraraśmiḥ ।। 7.69.39 ॥

translations.english: Having completely struck down the terror of the three worlds with a single arrow, the great hero of the Raghu dynasty, Shatrughna, shone forth with his excellent bow and arrow, just like the sun dispelling darkness.
